text: KDDI Corporation (TSE code 9433) lists its major shareholders as of 31 March 2026 as The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account, 15.77%), KYOCERA Corporation (14.75%), TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION (9.54%) and Custody Bank of Japan, Ltd. (Trust Account, 6.63%), with no other holder above 2%; in its breakdown by investor type, national and local governments hold 0.00%.
short: KDDI is Tokyo-listed; its largest holders are Master Trust (15.77%), Kyocera (14.75%), Toyota (9.54%) and Custody Bank (6.63%).
